sentences.en: Also, increased temperatures may require that lubricants be changed frequently.
sentences.zh: 此外，温度升高可能需要更频繁地更换润滑油。

sentences.en: A child has a higher temperature than an adult does.
Man, too, has been given protective devices against extreme temperatures.
sentences.zh: 人类也得到了抵御极端气温的保护装置。
